notes: Two separate map panels with their own placement: the upper panel (E. 3rd to E. Pearl, Walnut to Main, y about 650-1750) and the lower panel (E. Pearl to E. 2nd, y about 2800-4250). E. Pearl appears in both, so its Walnut and Main crossings are recorded once per panel. Reynolds (printed REYNOLDS, no width printed, about 25 ft between faces, narrowing slightly and shifting west south of the alley) runs from E. Pearl, where it ends (T), across E. 2nd to sheet 102. The 15' alley from Walnut to Reynolds is recorded as Dunseth Alley: its name label is mostly covered by a paste-over and only ...UNSE... can be read, which matches Dunseth Alley on sheet 111 west of Walnut; treat the name as probable. The unnamed 10' alley (printed ALLEY) from Reynolds to Main is about 13 px (4 ft) north of the Dunseth Alley centreline at Reynolds, so the two nearly line up across Reynolds. The large numerals 2 and 3 printed in the alleys are not widths.
